questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

Some pigs are frogs.

All bats are pigs.

Conclusions:

(I) At least some bats are frogs

(II) All pigs are bats.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2debf9dda0027a3b4b3dd54e1c263caa7383b0bf20ca68c9abcf986cb99db84.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) At least some bats are frogs → False ( As there is no direction between bats and fogs. so, it can be a possibility but definite)

(II) All pigs are bats → False (As, All bats are pigs. so, All pigs are bats can be a possibility but definite)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question:
8 is related to 62 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 11 is related to 119. To which of the following is 15 related, following the same logic?

[NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. Eg. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting / multiplying, etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Number² - 2**

8 is related to 62

→ 8² - 2

→ 64 - 2

→ 62

And, 

11 is related to 119

→ 112 - 2

→ 121 - 2

→ 119.

Similarly,

→ 152 - 2

→ 225 - 2

→ 223.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
What should come in place of ‘?’ in the given series?

17, 32, 93, 460, 3213, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

17, 32, 93, 460, 3213, ?

17 × 2 - 2 = 32 

32 × 3 - 3 = 93

93 × 5 - 5 = 460

460 × 7 - 7 = 3213

**3213 × 11 - 11 = 35332**

Thus**, **The missing term in the series is **35332**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

16 ÷ 4 + 18 − 14 × 7 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 16 ÷ 4 + 18 − 14 × 7 = ?

Now, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 16 × 4 − 18 + 14 ÷ 7

Using BODMAS:

⇒ __**16 × 4**__ - 18 + __**14 ÷ 7**__

⇒ 64 - 18 + 2

⇒ 66 - 18

= 48

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
